description.zh: 「仍然记得」的时间档案新章节：选一个尚未抵达的年份，写下一封会被封存的信。单屏网页，含年份刻度、实时信件预览、封缄动画与已寄出的信列表。
description.en: A new chapter for Still, Remember: choose a future year, write a letter, seal it. A single web screen with a year dial, live letter preview, wax-seal interaction and a list of letters already sent.

notes: Embedded in the React app at #/letters via public/letters/letter.html?embed=1.
